retrieval.question: what drove the change in consolidated gross margin for the latest fiscal year

quotes.text: Gross profit, defined as sales less cost of sales, was $4.588 billion, or 30.3% of net sales, in 2025 compared to $4.514 billion, or 29.4% of net sales, in 2024.

Segment profit drivers are left out too: they explain segment margin, not consolidated gross margin.
